goal: Restore the fail-closed malformed Slice marker check that amendment-multiline-slice-entries (#320) removed from baselineHistoricalSlices in plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts. Before #320, a historical baseline line whose single Slice marker id does not satisfy the tracker id grammar (ownershipMarkerValue: [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}), for example slice-id=:bogus or slice-id=a:b, made the amendment return ambiguous_remote_state with the message 'historical Slice <id> has a malformed Slice marker in the approved Parent baseline'; after #320 the same baseline is published with status updated and the malformed marker carried into the Parent. Delegated choices: (1) reinstate the check on the entry's marker line with the same message, for historical entries only (amended Slices stay exempt as before #320), placed before any entry is extracted so a malformed marker causes zero remote mutations; (2) all #320 behavior (multiline entries, duplicate/heading/missing-footer rejection) is unchanged; (3) no docs or changeset change: the #320 changeset already announces rejection of ambiguous entries before remote mutations, and docs/agents/issue-tracker.md never enumerated this pre-existing case.

acceptance.assertion: bun test tests/plugin-package-runtime.test.ts -t "initiative amendment publication" passes, including a new parameterized case built with withAmendmentBase that appends a historical Slice line carrying a malformed marker (slice-id=:bogus and slice-id=a:b) after the done entry: the amendment returns status ambiguous_remote_state, its message names the malformed Slice marker, and gh.mutations is unchanged. All existing cases in the describe block, including the #320 multiline preservation and boundary rejection cases, still pass.
